framebuffer_branch.explanation: tbnz w8, #0, 0x18434d1e0 (little-endian bytes 48 0b 00 37). w8 is the result of the EDR-headroom versus CA_FP16_MIN_HEADROOM test combined with the panel-headroom > 8 test. The target returns the already-loaded 'RGhA' pixel format. Replacing this instruction with NOP suppresses that normal headroom-triggered FP16 route, matching the semantics of the 24A446 patch; the separately cleared FORCE_FP16 and ALLOW_EDR_MIRRORING bytes cover the following override routes.

evidence: Verified: QuartzCore export trie contains _CARenderServerStart at image base 0x1842d4000 + 0x2fa544 = 0x1845ce544.
Verified: local symbols identify init_debug=0x1843db3f0, debug_values=0x1edf3e420, and _ca_debug_options=0x1edf3e5cc.

Verified independently: init_debug loops over 96 float-option pointers and stores str s0,[0x1edf3e420,index,lsl#2]; decoded table entries 21 and 81 point to CA_DISPLAY_EDR_HEADROOM and CA_FP16_MIN_HEADROOM respectively.
Verified independently: framebuffer_pixel_format loads the two float values from 0x1edf3e564 (threshold) and, via Display::edr_headroom, 0x1edf3e474 (override).
Verified: init_debug loops over 300 bool-option pointers and stores bytes at 0x1edf3e5cc+index; decoded entries 129 and 159 point to CA_FORCE_FP16_FRAMEBUFFER and CA_ALLOW_EDR_MIRRORING.
Verified independently: framebuffer_pixel_format directly loads _ca_debug_options+0x81 at 0x18434d080 and +0x9f at 0x18434d08c, each followed by a branch to the RGhA return path.

Verified: local symbol __ZN2CA12WindowServer12IOMFBDisplay24framebuffer_pixel_formatEv is 0x18434cff4; disassembly shows RGhA loaded into w19 and the headroom decision tbnz at 0x18434d078 targeting its return block.
Verified: local symbol CADeviceIsVirtualized::is_virtualized is 0x1edf390c1; CADeviceIsVirtualized_block_invoke stores its result to that byte, and framebuffer_pixel_format reads it.

normal_uncompressed_format.note: The ordinary non-deep candidate is loaded by mov/movk into w21. this+0x2b0 bit 3 instead selects 0x62336138 (b3a8); subsequent code may replace either candidate with a compressed FourCC.

headroom_panel_already_patched.condition: Display EDR headroom exceeds CA_FP16_MIN_HEADROOM and the panel headroom exceeds 8.
headroom_panel_already_patched.note: This is not the 24A446 +0xf0 virtualized branch.

force_fp16.minimal_change: NOP (0xd503201f), allowing normal BGRA/compression selection; runtime value is already zero.

allow_edr_mirroring.minimal_change: NOP (0xd503201f), allowing normal BGRA/compression selection; runtime value is already zero.

display_own_fp16_flag.condition: The byte at this+0x68c8 is nonzero. This is the 24B156 equivalent of the 24A446 this+0x6840 flag.
display_own_fp16_flag.minimal_change: NOP (0xd503201f), allowing the later normal BGRA/compression selector to run.

precompression_display_gate.condition: After this+0x75bf equals 1, this+0x6b88 is non-null with the accepted encoded type range, the byte at this+0x75e6 is nonzero.
precompression_display_gate.effect: Skips the normal selector while w19 still holds RGhA; later code returns/preserves that candidate.
precompression_display_gate.minimal_change: NOP (0xd503201f), allowing CADeviceIsVirtualized and then the normal selector to be evaluated. This path was not identified by a named local symbol.

virtualized.effect: Bypasses the ordinary BGRA/compressed-format selector while w19 still contains RGhA.
virtualized.minimal_change: NOP (0xd503201f). This affects only this decision and falls through to the ordinary selector.
virtualized.evidence: Both builds use framebuffer_pixel_format+0xf0 and the identical word 0x37000608.

post_selection_early_return.condition: The byte at this+0x75d4 is nonzero.
post_selection_early_return.effect: Returns the current candidate unchanged. It can preserve RGhA delivered by the precompression or virtualized bypass, but does not itself select RGhA.
post_selection_early_return.minimal_change: No patch recommended; remove the upstream RGhA selector instead.

virtualized_initialization.write_zero_behavior: framebuffer_pixel_format executes ldrb from 0x1edf390c1 on every call. If the once initializer has already run, a plugin write of zero persists; if written before first initialization, MGGetBoolAnswer may overwrite it later. The observed nonzero value confirms initialization occurred in this process.

recommended_patch.reason: Exact old-build semantic equivalent and narrowly disables only QuartzCore framebuffer selection based on virtualization. It avoids changing the global CADeviceIsVirtualized result used by many unrelated QuartzCore paths.
